src = open('tests/test_rows.py').read()
src = src.replace('''def count_rows(wordset):
    """Minimal complete DFA state count for the finite language wordset (incl. dead)."""
    words = set(wordset)
    # all prefixes
    prefixes = {w[:j] for w in words for j in range(len(w)+1)}
    residuals = {}
    for u in prefixes:
        res = frozenset(w[len(u):] for w in words if w.startswith(u))
        residuals[u] = res
    uniq = set(residuals.values())
    return len(uniq) + 1  # + dead residual (empty set may or may not be present)''',
'''def count_rows(wordset):
    """Minimal complete DFA state count for the finite language wordset (incl. dead)."""
    words = set(tuple(w) for w in wordset)
    prefixes = {w[:j] for w in words for j in range(len(w)+1)}
    uniq = set()
    for u in prefixes:
        res = frozenset(w[len(u):] for w in words if w[:len(u)] == u)
        uniq.add(res)
    empty = frozenset()
    n = len(uniq)
    if empty not in uniq:
        n += 1   # dead residual
    return n''')
